text:
Maya (releases): Heads-up: urgent hotfix candidate for tokenizer crash in prod-eu1 affecting a small percentage of requests. PR #4829 merged, patch reverts a brittle regex that hit long inputs. Need expedited deploy in the next change window (15m). Details: https://git.internal/r/4829 and notes https://confluence/internal/2.3.1-hotfix

Deploy Bot: CI: ✅ all checks passed. Image built: gcr.io/redwood/serving:2.3.1-hotfix. To deploy (canary): `./deploy.sh hotfix --cluster eu1 --image gcr.io/redwood/serving:2.3.1-hotfix --canary=10`

Leo (eng-release): @Maya can you confirm rollback plan and whether 2.3.0 is pinned in eu1? Also any migration or schema changes?

Maya (releases): Rollback: yes 2.3.0 is pinned in prod-eu1. Rollback command: `kubectl set image deployment/serving serving=gcr.io/redwood/serving:2.3.0 -n prod-eu1` We'll monitor error rate and traces for 5m after canary. No schema changes.

Sophie (oncall): :rotating_light: I'm oncall. We need two approvers for expedited. tagging @Jordan and @Leo. Request: limit canary to 10% for 5m initial check.

Jordan (prod-eng): Approve for canary only. I'll watch metrics/traces. Conditions: auto-rollback if 5xx > 0.5% OR p95 latency regresses > 1s.

Leo (eng-release): Approve :thumbsup: Auto-rollback enabled. Keep me looped if any anomaly.

Ops Approvals Bot: Expedite approval recorded. approver=Jordan, approver=Leo, count=2, window=15m, token=EXP-99a. Proceed when ready.

Maya (releases): Launching canary now.

Deploy Bot: Starting canary rollout to prod-eu1 at 10% (5 pods). Command: `deployctl rollout start --cluster eu1 --image gcr.io/redwood/serving:2.3.1-hotfix --canary=10`

Deploy Bot: Canary health checks: 30s passed. Metrics: ErrorRate=0.12%, p95=0.62s, traces=no new error signatures.

Sophie (oncall): Logs look clean from my side, no stack traces.

Jordan (prod-eng): I see a small cpu spike but nothing alarming. Continue to 50% after 3m.

Maya (releases): Proceeding to 50% now.

Deploy Bot: Rollout to 50% complete. Health: ErrorRate=0.14%, p95=0.68s. Auto-rollback still clear.

Leo (eng-release): Reminder to pin the hotfix image in the release notes and update rollback instructions.

Maya (releases): Done — release notes updated and image pinned. Notifying CS for any customer comms.

Deploy Bot: Full rollout started. All pods updating in prod-eu1. Final status: success. Version 2.3.1-hotfix live in eu1.

Jordan (prod-eng): :tada: Nice. I'll continue monitoring for 30m. If anything pops, I'll reopen the incident channel.

Maya (releases): Thanks everyone — closing this thread.
